title: psycopg2 "Can't adapt type" when using any() on array of enums

labels.name: near-term release
labels.description: addition to the milestone which indicates this should be in a near-term release

body:
**Describe the bug**
"Can't adapt type" from psycopg2 when using `any()` on array-of-enums column

**To Reproduce**

```py
import enum
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, MetaData, Table, Column, Enum
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import ARRAY

engine = create_engine('postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost/bug')
meta = MetaData()

class Options(enum.Enum):
    OPTION1 = '1'
    OPTION2 = '2'
    OPTION3 = '3'

table = Table(
    'bug', meta,
    Column('options', ARRAY(Enum(Options))),
)
meta.create_all(engine)
with engine.connect() as conn:
    conn.execute(table.select().where(table.c.options.any(Options.OPTION1)))
```

**Error**
